lines.text: City lights are calling, got that current in my veins
Moving through the crowd like I’m breaking all the chains
You see me shining, baby, can’t look away
This energy between us is about to overtake
It’s rising up, can’t hold it back no more
The second our eyes meet, we’re opening the door
Midnight voltage, running through my body
Electric love, you know you can’t stop me
Feel the power, let it take control
Midnight voltage, lighting up my soul
Baby come and get it, feel it in the air
Midnight voltage, take me if you dare
Dancing on the edge of what we both desire
Every beat is pulling, setting hearts on fire
No more playing safe, we’re living for tonight
This spark we started’s burning way too bright
It’s rising up…
Midnight voltage…
Let the night explode
Midnight voltage (bigger layers and harmonies), running through my body…
